shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded region on one side of a graph
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The epigraph: the set of coordinate pairs on or above the function graph. Right image: A coordinate-plane solution region of a linear inequality; the dashed boundary is excluded.
Rationales: The label epi f specifies a set of points above f, while half-plane shading identifies points satisfying a linear inequality. Both fills encode an inequality-defined coordinate set; their boundary-inclusion details need not match.
